raw.details:
Overview

Where Industry Challenges Meet Student Innovation

Symbiosis Institute of Technology, Pune, in association with the IEEE Student Branch, SIT Pune, presents Synapse 1.0, an offline, industry-focused hackathon designed to bring together talented engineering students and real-world technology challenges.

Synapse 1.0 goes beyond conventional hackathons. Shortlisted teams will work on industry-relevant problem statements and develop practical, innovative solutions within an intensive 8-hour offline sprint at the SIT Pune campus.

The hackathon provides participants with an opportunity to experience real-world problem-solving, collaborate under time constraints, and showcase their technical skills to industry professionals.

What to Expect

  • 8-hour offline hackathon at Symbiosis Institute of Technology, Pune
  • Industry-driven problem statements
  • Multiple technical and AI-focused tracks
  • Mentorship and evaluation by industry professionals
  • Opportunity to build solutions to real-world challenges
  • Prize pool across tracks
  • Exposure to industry experts and fellow student innovators

Team Formation

  • Team size: 2–4 members
  • Each participant must have a laptop
  • Valid College ID is mandatory
  • Cross-disciplinary collaboration is encouraged
  • Cross-college/ Cross-department/ Cross-year teams are allowed.

Important Dates

  • 10 September 2026: Problem Statements Revealed
  • 10 September 2026: PPT/Concept Submission Begins
  • 15 September 2026 (Tentative) : Sponsors and Prize Pool reveal
  • 20 September 2026: Submission Deadline
  • 21 September 2026: Shortlisted Teams Announced
  • 26 September 2026: Grand Finale | 8-Hour Offline Hackathon

Problem statements

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1eQaB8ff8zm1NyZjAAIr-yj2xg_JXoRQJbga_ebcsRd8/edit?usp=sharing

Prizes & Recognition

Each track will have its own prize pool, with winning teams receiving cash prizes and merchandise.

Beyond the prizes, Synapse 1.0 gives participants the opportunity to gain practical experience, receive expert feedback, and demonstrate their problem-solving abilities in an industry-oriented environment.

Build. Innovate. Solve.

Whether you're passionate about Artificial Intelligence, software development, emerging technologies, or solving real-world problems, Synapse 1.0 is your platform to turn ideas into working solutions.

Bring your team. Take on the challenge. Build something that matters.

Note: Please bring your own hardware components.

  • Venue: Symbiosis Institute of Technology, Pune
  • Finale: 26 September 2026
  • Duration: 8 Hours
  • Team Size: 2–4 Members

Organized by

IEEE Student Branch, Symbiosis Institute of Technology, Pune

Register now and get ready to build, compete, and innovate at Synapse 1.0!
